tips.text: Raise Piloting to rank 5 before farming; it puts a waypoint on the derelict.
Farm Pluto Proxima or the Corpus Veil nodes only; their derelict always spawns, unlike the Grineer ones.
Pick the shortest mission type on the node; the cache pays the same whatever the objective.
Expect long dry spells; players report weeks of runs without a single part.
Most players collect it for mastery and treat the Void Relics from the same cache as the consolation prize.
